purpose: Freeze-before-run acceptance of core experiment selection and separate mechanism-feature contribution on previously unused physical reaction-process data.

freeze.result_policy: A full result is valid only after status is frozen, both revisions identify the preceding committed candidate, and the evaluation fingerprint matches every method, adapter, data, dependency, and normalized protocol input.

threshold_rule.rationale: Fixed-prevalence finite-pool comparison device; not a field reaction specification.

mechanism_features.name: reagent_contact_exposure
mechanism_features.basis: Residence time multiplied by reagent ratio is a low-dimensional contact-exposure interaction declared before outcomes were read.

threshold_rule.rationale: Fixed-prevalence finite-pool comparison device; not a field reaction specification.

mechanism_features.name: catalyst_temperature_exposure
mechanism_features.basis: Catalyst loading multiplied by temperature is a low-dimensional catalytic-condition interaction declared before outcomes were read.

episodes.initial_history_policy: Unique random initial settings shared by every paired method; episodes already at target are excluded before any method runs.

statistics.response_surface_added_value_rule: At least one linear or quadratic response-surface comparison must have a relative-trial-reduction 95% CI lower bound above zero.

claim_boundaries.core_pass: The current method-selection policy passed this fixed public reaction-process acceptance for additional-result-query efficiency.
claim_boundaries.mechanism_pass: The two preregistered low-dimensional interactions contributed on this fixed public acceptance only.
claim_boundaries.failure: A failed gate remains not demonstrated and cannot be hidden by an aggregate or by another claim passing.
forbidden: universal superiority to DOE or response surfaces
validated physical law or causal mechanism
transfer to another process without local replay
